title: Razorpay UPI collect requests timing out in west India
description: Checkout success rate dropped sharply for UPI collect payments while internal checkout, Redis, and Postgres latency stayed normal.
signals: Razorpay dashboard showed elevated pending payments
internal checkout error budget burn reached 4.2x
root_cause: Razorpay acquiring-bank route degradation affected collect authorization callbacks for several Mumbai PSP routes.
resolution: Shifted UPI collect and high-value card traffic to Cashfree fallback, replayed pending payment status reconciliation, and kept Razorpay disabled until callback lag normalized.

title: Razorpay card capture API returning intermittent 504 responses
description: Card payment capture calls intermittently returned 504 even though authorization succeeded and order service logs were clean.
signals: Razorpay incident acknowledged by support before public status update
root_cause: Razorpay capture API gateway saturation caused successful authorizations to remain uncaptured until retry.
resolution: Queued capture retries with idempotency keys, temporarily disabled instant fulfillment for uncaptured card payments, and reconciled captures after vendor recovery.

title: Razorpay webhook delivery delayed after successful payments
description: Payments succeeded at the gateway but fulfillment remained pending because webhook delivery was delayed in batches.
signals: no matching deploy in fulfillment service
root_cause: Razorpay webhook fanout queue lagged while direct payment fetch APIs remained healthy.
resolution: Enabled polling fallback for captured payments older than three minutes, replayed delayed webhooks with dedupe, and reduced fulfillment holdback after queues drained.

title: Razorpay payout creation stuck in queued state
description: Merchant payouts were accepted but stayed queued beyond the normal settlement window, delaying same-day disbursals.
signals: queued payouts older than 20 minutes exceeded 1800
Razorpay API returned 200 for create requests
bank reference missing on affected payouts
support confirmed beneficiary bank rail delay
root_cause: Razorpay payout processor delayed routing to beneficiary bank rails while accepting payout create requests.
resolution: Paused new instant payouts for affected banks, sent merchant-facing delay notices, and released queued payouts after Razorpay confirmed drain completion.

title: MSG91 OTP delivery degraded for Airtel numbers
description: Login OTP delivery dropped for Airtel subscribers while OTP generation and auth APIs remained healthy.
signals: OTP delivery success fell to 61% for Airtel
root_cause: MSG91 primary Airtel transactional route experienced carrier-level delivery delay after DLT filtering changes.
resolution: Shifted OTP traffic to backup MSG91 route and enabled WhatsApp OTP fallback for repeat requests after 60 seconds.

title: MSG91 DLT template mismatch causing promotional classification
description: Transactional account alert SMS messages were accepted by MSG91 but delivered late because the route classified them as promotional.
signals: template variable count differed from DLT registration
customer support tickets increased for missing balance alerts
root_cause: A template copy update added a variable not present in the registered DLT template, causing route downgrade.
resolution: Restored exact DLT-approved copy, purged cached template mapping, and replayed undelivered transactional alerts.

title: MSG91 delivery receipt webhook backlog delayed OTP state updates
description: SMS messages were delivered, but delayed delivery receipts made the support dashboard show OTPs as pending.
signals: MSG91 API delivery lookup returned delivered
root_cause: MSG91 delivery receipt webhook queue lagged while actual SMS delivery stayed healthy.
resolution: Updated dashboard to prefer direct delivery lookup for pending records older than five minutes and replayed delayed DLR events idempotently.

title: MSG91 sender ID throttled during festival traffic spike
description: Transactional SMS send latency increased during a traffic spike even though MSG91 continued accepting messages.
signals: sender ID throughput capped near 320 SMS/min
queue growth started after campaign launch
root_cause: MSG91 sender ID throughput was throttled during regional carrier congestion.
resolution: Split eligible traffic across approved backup sender ID, suppressed non-critical alerts, and restored normal routing after carrier capacity recovered.

title: Cashfree payment status API lagging behind successful UPI transactions
description: UPI payments succeeded at bank level but Cashfree status API returned pending for several minutes, delaying order confirmation.
signals: pending status older than 8 minutes exceeded 2400
bank success webhook arrived before Cashfree status update
root_cause: Cashfree reconciliation pipeline lagged behind successful bank confirmations.
resolution: Extended pending order hold window, enabled bank-success webhook reconciliation, and replayed status checks after Cashfree lag cleared.

title: Cashfree payout webhook signature verification failing after key rotation
description: Payout completion webhooks began failing signature verification shortly after a Cashfree-side signing certificate rotation.
signals: signature key id changed in webhook header
no code deploy in webhook receiver
root_cause: Cashfree rotated webhook signing material before the receiver cache refreshed.
resolution: Fetched the new webhook key, accepted both old and new key ids during overlap, replayed failed payout completion webhooks, and shortened signing-key cache TTL.

title: Cashfree UPI intent degraded for Android checkout
description: Android users launching UPI intent from checkout saw payment app handoff failures while web checkout remained mostly healthy.
signals: Android UPI intent failure rate reached 44%
Cashfree hosted checkout success stayed above 93%
deep link open telemetry dropped for GPay and PhonePe
no Android release in prior 48 hours
root_cause: Cashfree UPI intent link generation returned malformed PSP parameters for a subset of Android clients.
resolution: Disabled native UPI intent path, routed Android users to Cashfree hosted checkout, and restored intent after vendor patch validation.

title: Cashfree refund API accepted requests but delayed ARN generation
description: Refund requests were accepted by Cashfree but ARN generation lagged, increasing customer support contacts.
signals: ARN missing for 37% of refunds older than 30 minutes
root_cause: Cashfree downstream processor delayed ARN generation while refund creation APIs continued accepting requests.
resolution: Updated support messaging to show accepted-but-processing state, reduced duplicate refund retries, and backfilled ARN values after processor recovery.

title: AWS S3 increased 5xx errors on KYC document uploads
description: KYC uploads to the Mumbai S3 bucket returned intermittent 503 SlowDown and 500 InternalError responses.
signals: AWS Health noted increased error rates in ap-south-1
root_cause: AWS S3 ap-south-1 experienced elevated write error rates for a subset of partitions used by the KYC upload bucket.
resolution: Enabled exponential backoff with jitter, temporarily routed new KYC uploads to ap-south-2 bucket, and reconciled replicated objects after AWS recovery.

title: AWS S3 pre-signed URL uploads failing after clock drift
description: Customers saw SignatureDoesNotMatch on KYC uploads even though S3 itself was healthy.
signals: upload API nodes showed NTP drift above 6 minutes
failures clustered by one node pool
root_cause: One upload API node pool generated pre-signed URLs with stale system time after NTP sync failure.
resolution: Drained the affected node pool, resynced NTP, shortened URL TTL during recovery, and invalidated stale upload sessions.

title: AWS S3 list operation throttling slowed reconciliation jobs
description: Nightly reconciliation jobs slowed because S3 ListObjectsV2 calls were throttled on a hot prefix.
signals: PUT and GET success rates normal
requests concentrated under daily export prefix
root_cause: Reconciliation workers concentrated list requests on a single hot S3 prefix during backfill.
resolution: Reduced list concurrency, partitioned reconciliation by hashed prefixes, and resumed catch-up after throttling cleared.

title: AWS S3 object replication lag delayed compliance archive
description: Compliance archive objects were written successfully but cross-region replication lagged beyond the expected 15-minute window.
root_cause: A replication backlog built up after a large export burst exceeded configured replication throughput expectations.
resolution: Paused non-critical archive exports, monitored replication backlog until drain, and split future exports into smaller windows.

title: WhatsApp Cloud API template messages stuck in accepted state
description: Order confirmation WhatsApp messages were accepted by Meta but not delivered to a large subset of users.
signals: Meta status updated 22 minutes after first alert
root_cause: WhatsApp Cloud API regional delivery queue degraded while message submit API remained available.
resolution: Switched critical order confirmations to SMS fallback after two minutes, replayed undelivered WhatsApp messages with dedupe, and resumed normal routing after delivery callbacks recovered.

title: WhatsApp Cloud API media upload failures for invoice PDFs
description: Invoice PDF media uploads to WhatsApp Cloud API intermittently failed, blocking invoice delivery over WhatsApp.
signals: text template messages continued to send
Meta Graph API status showed media endpoint degradation
root_cause: WhatsApp Cloud API media endpoint had elevated 5xx errors while template send endpoints remained healthy.
resolution: Sent invoice links as text-only fallback, queued media retries with idempotent media ids, and replayed PDF attachments after endpoint recovery.

title: WhatsApp Cloud API quality rating drop throttled onboarding messages
description: New-user onboarding messages were throttled after WhatsApp quality rating dropped from high to medium.
signals: message throughput capped at tier limit
quality rating changed in WhatsApp Manager
delivery failures concentrated on onboarding template
unsubscribe complaints increased after campaign import
root_cause: A broad onboarding campaign increased negative feedback and lowered WhatsApp template quality rating, triggering throughput limits.
resolution: Paused low-intent campaign audience, limited onboarding sends to verified signups, and monitored quality recovery before ramping traffic.

title: WhatsApp Cloud API webhook verification expired after certificate renewal
description: Inbound message and delivery callbacks stopped after TLS certificate renewal changed the webhook verification path behavior.
signals: webhook callback volume dropped to near zero
root_cause: Webhook verification endpoint rejected Meta challenge requests after certificate renewal changed a path rewrite rule.
resolution: Restored the webhook challenge route exemption, revalidated the callback URL in Meta dashboard, and replayed missed delivery state from message lookup.
